triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '4. `sched_mfma(4)` regresses the interleaved-loadV PV loop but helps the pure-MFMA variant' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 4. `sched_mfma(4)` regresses the interleaved-loadV PV loop but helps the pure-MFMA variant

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL Flash Attention on MI308X (gfx942) -- 4. `sched_mfma(4)` regresses the interleaved-loadV PV loop but helps the pure-MFMA variant

payload.attempted: `rocdl.sched_mfma(N)` is documented as a hint to interleave ds_read with MFMA. Adding it to the PV inner loop "should" help.
payload.lesson: scheduling hints assume a specific loop shape. Verify the shape before adding them. SageAttention's V27 sched_mfma(4) win was specifically on its pre-loaded-V structure.

established_fact.mechanism: in the "load + MFMA interleaved" loop, the hint conflicts with the explicit ds_reads inside the loop body, forcing the scheduler into a suboptimal arrangement. In the "all-V-pre-loaded + pure MFMA" loop, the hint is decoration — the body is already what `sched_mfma(N)` aims for.
